text:
maria: Quick update 1 — launching a limited preview for A800-Slim dedicated micro-pools in eu-west-3 (Paris) and ca-west (Vancouver). Goal: ultra-low-cost sustained inference for high-qps edge proxies. Reservation window opens 2026-04-10 04:00 UTC via Console + API. :loudspeaker:
tom: A800-Slim = specs? perf vs a800-full?
maria: A800-Slim is a denser power-profile SKU tuned for inference (reduced memory, optimized NVLink config). Expect ~75% of a800-full FP32 throughput but much better cost/slot. Recommended for int8 & int4 quantized models.
rachel: SLA / burst rules?
maria: SLA: 99.8% reserved availability. Burst: ephemeral pool bursts allowed up to 12% of region pool for 3m windows, 4x/day. Bursts may be limited on first 48h as we tune.
ops-bot: Fleet plan: eu-west-3: 40 units (10 clusters), ca-west: 28 units (7 clusters).
deply-bot: rollout plan: preview -> staggered GA. Preview reservations accepted for up to 8 units per org. Canary starts 2026-04-10 04:00 UTC.
tom: How to reserve via API?
rachel: API example (internal):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/dedicated/reservations
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"region":"eu-west-3","gpu_type":"a800-slim","units":2,"term_months":6}'
```
maria: Pricing for preview uses a non-billed test SKU (a800-slim.preview). No charges until you convert to a committed reservation or GA opt-in. Billing will communicate conversion terms.
billing: Note: conversion offers include prorated credits for existing a800-full reservations if you choose to migrate within 60 days. Reach out to billing@s.redwood for custom quotes.
sre-team: If you run latency-sensitive workloads, we recommend enabling KV-prefix caching and per-request affinity to avoid cross-cluster hops. We'll publish a perf note with tail-latency numbers later this week.
mar ia: small correction: office hours tomorrow 09:30 CET in #dedicated to walk folks through reservation & migration steps.
